title: Truemed Made HSA and FSA Dollars Easy To Use

segments.note: Starts directly on the positive impact claim so Truemed appears immediately.
Stephanie explains the core pain: useful health products get expensive fast.
Employer-funded account example: the money felt like free health purchases.
The strongest financial proof: pre-tax dollars can save roughly $30 per $100 in her example.
Interviewer asks whether using the benefit was easy or difficult.
Direct product UX proof: Truemed shows eligible items and reduces the flow to a few buttons and questions.
Letter of Medical Necessity payoff: the missing paperwork step for covering workout gear, infrared, red light, and supplements.
Interviewer asks how HSA/FSA felt before Truemed, setting up the contrast.
Ends on the clearest before/after: claims used to be rejected, then Truemed became a lifesaver.
